about_the_game:
Breaker of fatalism is an immersive live action interactive video game. You play the role of an ordinary urban youth who, due to an accident, awakens the ancient artifact hidden in your body. In an instant, you become the core of the competition among the three forces of heaven, earth, and humans. They have different methods, whether it's coercion or inducement, or pretending to win over, but every decision you make is like a stone thrown into the lake, creating ripples that move the world order and rewrite your own destiny.

The game utilizes live action filming, with a cinematic narrative and multiple branching storylines and real-time interactive gameplay, taking you into a tense and exciting vortex of power struggles, facing life and death tests. Is it to follow the will of heaven, or to change it against the will of heaven? Is it to be self-sufficient or to dominate sentient beings? All of this is written by your own hands with a unique destiny ending.

Jiang Yi, who grew up in an orphanage when he was young, has deep feelings with Wu Huan and Wu Jin, two sisters. The originally Buddhist life has become turbulent due to the emergence of gentle and gentle people. After experiencing life and death several times, I finally uncovered the mystery of my identity. But the truth of the world is far more complex than imagined.

Qingqiu, is she from heaven or hell? She exudes a mysterious aura that makes one involuntarily control their emotions. How many secrets do she have on her body.

Wu Huan, who has been reading poetry and books since childhood, is extraordinary and outstanding. She inherited the family business at a young age and is in charge of the Tiandao Group. Although she contributes to the organization of demon hunters, she does not agree with their actions on earth. Influenced by Jiang Hao, I am determined to expel the demon hunters and demons from the world, in order to break free from the control of the gods and earth saints.

Wu Jin, as Wu Huan's biological sister, felt suffocated by the radiance of her sister since childhood. She didn't like Wu Huan's well behaved style, but due to his quirky personality, she was accepted as a disciple by Jiang Hao and taught him everything she had learned throughout her life. She has loved Jiang Yi since childhood and is not stingy with her emotions and enthusiasm. After learning the truth about the world, she leads everyone into her own chess game.

Yao Wanqing, who has experienced family changes since childhood, has been extremely insecure, and over time, she has evolved into a competitive protective color. In her world, no outsider is allowed to enter her heart except for her brother. It wasn't until Jiang Yi's appearance that she gradually opened up her heart.

Ke Ren, on the surface, she appears to be a woman belonging to the big brother of the underworld, with unlimited glory, but behind the scenes, she is seen as a victim of the power sex trade by the big brother. Her true identity is not only that, but it seems to hide more secrets. She designed a series of serial illusions just to capture Jiang Yi's heart. But in the process of getting along with Jiang Yi, influenced by his sincerity, he gradually succumbed to love and faced a dilemma between love and family.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In this innovative interactive video game, Eastern fantasy collides fiercely with modern cities, and you become the core of the competition among the three forces of heaven, earth, and man. They have different methods, whether it's coercion or inducement, or pretending to win over, but every decision you make is like a stone thrown into the lake, creating ripples that move the world order and rewrite your own destiny.

With multiple plot branches and various fates, this power struggle that spans across heaven, earth, and man is waiting for you to embark on. When the final decision comes, can you bear the heavy burden of being the "master of destiny"?

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains a small amount of bloody, violent, gun, and alcohol abuse scenes, which may not be suitable for minors.
